title: C1: vanishing above degree two
statement:
Let $k$ be algebraically closed, let $C$ be a
smooth separated connected curve over $k$, and let
$n$ be a prime. Then the constant sheaf
$\mathbf F_n$ (see [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]) satisfies
$\mathcal C_1(C,\mathbf F_n)$ of
[def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions]: $H^q(C_{\Et},\mathbf F_n)=0$
for every $q>2$.

proof.text: By the definition of the constant sheaf F_n, every geometric stalk is the finite group Z/nZ, hence is killed by n; therefore F_n is a torsion etale sheaf. Applying the cohomological-dimension lemma for smooth separated connected curves to F_n gives H^q(C_Et,F_n)=0 for every q>2, which is exactly assertion C_1 in the eight curve assertions.
